defect: AU5 G04 (partly): a recorded building picked on the area map had no way to get its property card; cards-only confirmation was reachable only from the batch page, 100 per press.

decisions.D1: When an intake target names the picked building and it is recorded with no card and in no confirmation, the inspector shows the batch page's cards-only words for one building, the same caveat, a typed acknowledgement and 'Make the property card'. The press posts the existing cards-only confirmation (fresh requestKey, packages [], targets [this target]) through useConfirmationCommand, whose resend-on-uncertain and 409 handling are unchanged. The target is then re-read and followed through the case's one subscription (useRunStream) until carded, and the card dialog opens.
decisions.D2: A carded building shows 'Open the property card'; one listed in a confirmation shows its reason, locator and step and a batch link; any other readiness shows its label and words, its reason and 'Open batch' to /studio/work/cases/<caseId>/intake; a building no target names shows nothing.
decisions.D3: No target lookup by feature existed, so one read is added: GET /api/v1/ingestion/intake/targets/by-feature?featureId[&packageId]. The map holds no package for a recorded building (a proposal carries proposalPackageId), so packageId is optional: with it the target is read in that package; without it in the packages that recorded the feature, read through physical_feature_revisions (primary key on feature_id) and UNIQUE(package_id,locator) on targets, so no index or schema step. Several targets: the furthest stage, then the latest. Case access is intakeCaseTx on the target's case, as the target page; none is 404 NOT_FOUND.
decisions.cardDialog: The Studio has no building-level card dialog (UnitCardDialog is per unit and asks the snapshot's unit cards). The dialog opened here is the shared Dialog with the run's own ArtefactLinks: card PDF of the exact revision, verification page, record.
decisions.words: cardsOnlyWords(1) now reads in the singular ('This recorded building will get ...'); every other count reads as before.
decisions.scope: The map's BuildingInspector only (MapWorkspace passes the section; RegisterPage and WorkspacePage are unchanged). WindowedArea, which draws areas over one display read (the NYC area), uses WindowedInspector and is not changed here.

tests.inputs: The captured E3B run of 11 October (docs/evidence/gf1/e3b/targets.json, confirmation.json): a ready building (good: not recorded) and the same building carded and verified (difficult: full artefacts). The recorded-no-card and listed states are that carded target with its later artefacts removed, stated in the test.
tests.studio: BuildingCard.test.tsx: recorded without card (words, disabled press until typed; pressCards posts {packages: [], targets: [this]} equal to the batch page's confirmBody cards-only body; stored once; reads follow listed -> carded and followCard opens; the dialog shows the card PDF, verification and 'Card consistent'); carded (offers 'Open the property card', no dialog until asked); not recorded (ready label and words, batch link, no press); not a target (404 NOT_FOUND -> null -> nothing; a server without the route is an error, not none; query carries featureId and packageId).
tests.server: intake-targets.test.ts: recorded read uses physical_feature_revisions with [featureId, null], orders by stage, checks the target's case; a proposal read passes the packageId; none -> 404; archived case -> INGESTION_CASE_ARCHIVED; a malformed featureId is refused before any statement. intake-run.controller.test.ts: strict query (one featureId, at most one packageId, no other field) and the published IntakeTargetSchema response.
